reviews.author: Victor R
reviews.title: Well chuffed!
reviews.content: Lovely marina based bar, very clean and comfortable with excellent food and fantastic staff, good prices too for being located in a more up-market area! 😊

reviews.author: Gavin H
reviews.title: Chilled drinks
reviews.content:
Nice chilled unpressurized drinks comfortable seating, friendly staff, great location.
Didn't have food but looked good for others.

reviews.author: Lisa M
reviews.title: Home from home
reviews.content: The location was wonderful, and the owners were very courteous. The pricing was reasonable and provided great value for our experience. We definitely plan to return, as the staff made us feel welcomed throughout our visit. I would highly recommend this place to friends and family.

reviews.author: Dave N.
reviews.title: Awful place with awful cocktails in a good location. Not recommended.
reviews.content:
Awful place. We sat there as it looked nice and was a good location, at the new marina.
I had what is my favourite cocktail- Long Island iced tea- when it came and I tasted it I knew something was wrong. It tasted awful and also the coke added was flat as if it had been poured from a bar tap without gas.
Others in our party had marguerites, which were also poor and tasted weird.
I had to send mine back and didn’t take any replacement and got the price taken off the bill.
All the cocktails tasted as they were out a packet, not sure if true or not, but not a great experience.
We left very disappointed never to return

reviews.author: niksie81
reviews.title: Tasty burgers
reviews.content: Nice bar in the port of Albufeira. Friendly staff and a good menu for a nice bite to eat. We have been there twice, the 1st time only for a drink and the 2nd time we had delicious burgers. Staff is not intrusive

reviews.author: Climber46822442420
reviews.title: Sharkeys is the one
reviews.content: I can honestly say this place is absolutely fantastic always service with a smile ,Freindly and courteous, the food is exceptional I had the spicy chicken salad and burgers there and was amazing,Chris ,Ed and the team know how to look after their customers thanks again for great hospitality as always Jason and Karen

reviews.author: Archie S
reviews.title: Perfect find
reviews.content: What a great decision this was for lunch, English ran and none the worse for it, good value food, v good service, would highly recommend

reviews.author: Michelleneil1983
reviews.title: The best cocktails
reviews.content: Stopped here yesterday for some cocktails and I have to say they were the best we have tried in the last 12 days we have been here and we have tried a lot.  Strawberry daiquiri was to die for and you could taste there was plenty of alcohol in it and even better we got them half price as it was during their happy hour which was 6pm to 8pm.  Staff were also lovely and service was great.  The seating area was comfy and nice and relaxed.  Would highly recommend and will be back and will try the food next time too

reviews.author: Debbie H
reviews.title: Perfect for drinks , relaxed vibes and chats with our mate Eddy
reviews.content: Sharky’s Bar is a regular place we visit every time we travel to Portugal—and for good reason! Eddy, as always, was friendly, chatty, and provided amazing service. He’s such a lovely friend and really makes the place feel welcoming. His cocktail-making skills are top-notch, and every drink is made with care. Can’t recommend it enough!

reviews.author: Francesca W
reviews.title: Absolutely delightful, good prices and delicious drinks 🍷
reviews.content: My boyfriend and I have become regulars during happy hour for our two week holiday here! The staff are very attentive and kind, even remembering our usual order. We have encountered Yobi and Darcie most nights (forgive misspelling) and they have been nothing but delightful. We hope to see them again next year!

reviews.author: andygibbo6
reviews.title: Fatastic staff , great location
reviews.content: Went in for drinks a few times , the staff were absolutely lovely and the drinks were really well priced , all with a great view of the marina

reviews.author: Carmel_C_12_12
reviews.title: Fab food &. Cocktails
reviews.content:
We were staying in the multi coloured apartments  above sharkys.
We were there for 2 weeks.
We had lunches , snacks , dinners and we definitely tried all the fab cocktails available , half price from 6-8pm daily.
All the staff   especially the 2  English ladies were so friendly and helpful.
It's a great location beside the marina .
The seats on the decking are comfy , good fans to keep cool . Music not too loud .
Most evenings we went down for a drink or three 😜 while our teenagers got ready.
Everything was great .
Nice place to sit and people watch 
We loved it ,

reviews.author: PilgrimNic
reviews.title: Great Food for Great value!
reviews.content:
Went here because we fancied burgers!

The menu is pretty much burgers, hot dogs and baguettes!
The burgers have novelty shark names. They all come with crisps, we got extra chips with ours but it is not needed unless your starving! The burgers are massive and you get 2 hot dogs per serving. Food was absolutely lovely. Happened to be happy hour too, we tried several cocktails all of which we're smashing and the shots too! Value for money, burgers we're €8 to €13 and hotdogs around €9!

reviews.author: Ellie J
reviews.title: Lovely bar staff and incredible prices
reviews.content: incredible prices at happy hour and the bar staff were so lovely, had a brilliant experience- would recommend to anyone

reviews.author: Julie A
reviews.title: Super comfy sports and food at the Marina
reviews.content: We actually visited Sharky’s on 6 occasions during a 10 day stay in Albufeira. Seating on the decking is super comfy. Chris the owner is so welcoming and all of the staff are brilliant. We ordered the Tuna and Cheese Toasties … perfect. Also had the Great White Burger and the Fish Finger sandwich. NOT all on the same day of course!!! Go to Sharky’s you will not be disappointed 😊

reviews.author: Jan n Mark
reviews.title: Excellent Bar
reviews.content: This is a great bar with friendly staff who are always welcoming and happy.   It is a brilliant place to relax and enjoy the Marina setting and enjoy excellent cocktails and beer in a wonderful atmosphere - highly recommend a visit 🍺🍹😍

reviews.author: Pub Monster Neil
reviews.title: Another great visit
reviews.content:
On our last day of our weeks holiday in Albufeira my twin brother and I headed to Albufeira Marina, with temperatures hitting 32 degrees Celsius we decided to drop by Sharky's Bar ,been here before on previous holidays to this sun drenched resort, always had a good time and so it proved on our latest visit. 
A great looking bar, interior is superb, very traditional, light and airy, an eye catching serving bar dominates the main room, pubby decor and furnishings, big screens to enjoy the sport and plenty of seating options spread throughout this bar both inside and outside looking out onto the busy and bustling marina, its just a really good bar to unwind in. 
We sat outside were we ordered bottles of beer from Central De Cervejas Brewery  ( Sagres beer  ) and these were served in excellent condition being iced cold and sparkling, we chilled out and soaked up the great vibe in this busy and popular bar while we sipped our beers. 
A big fan of this most famous of Portuguese beers, its a golden, light and hoppy lager style beer bursting with taste and very easy to drink especially when served freezing cold as in this bar, its hardly surprising that this bar is so popular with beers served in this good a condition. 
We both really enjoyed our beers in here before we moved on and although our visit was only fleeting as on every other visit to Sharky's Bar we had a very positive experience, its a bar easy to locate on Albufeira Marina, in my opinion one of the most beautiful area's of this beautiful resort.

reviews.author: Stephen Kelly
reviews.title: Amazing Bar On The Marina.
reviews.content:
Sharky's is a fantastic bar thats located on the marina and was one of the three pub's and bars we visited in this superb area.This bar offer's a superb food and drinks range and when we visited here it was really busy which is how we like bars.
Sharkys bar has an excellent interior with a maritime themed look and feel with brilliant fixtures and features relating to the sea.It's got a fantastic terrace and on our visit this is where we sat as it was really warm.When we went to here we had a couple of bottles of Sagres beers which where excellent and were well priced.
It's a superb bar that's located in a superb area of Albufeira and it's a bar that's worth going to if your around this area.(This is my first review of Sharky's Bar).
Opening Hours. 
Monday-Sunday-12.00-00.00.
Hours May Differ From Above.

reviews.author: Colin S
reviews.title: Nice wee bar, Albufeira
reviews.content: Found all staff to be very friendly in this wee spot perfectly located in Albufeira Marina.  Few beers and football on TV with everything else nearby.

reviews.author: ShropshireReviewer
reviews.title: Fantastic Service
reviews.content:
Great bar, situated on the marina with comfortable seating & a lovely view.
Reasonably priced drinks & a happy hour between 6-8pm.
The service was spot on, I would definitely return.

reviews.author: colin s
reviews.title: Great cocktails and service
reviews.content: Cracking cocktails in a lovely setting.  First time down the Albufeira marina,  straight into Sharkys bar,  lovely setting ,and happy hour to top it off between 6-8pm.  1 of the best I’ve ever had .

reviews.author: Veuve74
reviews.title: Lunch & Drinks after sailing
reviews.content: We popped in here for lunch after sailing and it was a great find.  Very friendly and relaxed, comfortable seating right in the heart of the marina.  Drinks tasty and cold, tasty food and generous portions that were good value for money.

reviews.author: Naia
reviews.title: Simple and good! Good value for money
reviews.content: The place is very good for a little snack. We tasted the little croques which are simple, good and at a very reasonable price. I also enjoyed the white wine sangria. The staff is very kind.

reviews.author: Emily S
reviews.title: Lovely place to visit - very friendly staff
reviews.content:
Lovely place to visit. 
Great view of the marina, such friendly staff, nothing is to much trouble, and they take the time to talk to you which is great. 
They show all the sport have live singers all round great place. We have been to Portugal 7-8 times and we visit here every time.

reviews.author: mr t
reviews.title: Lovely family friendly bar.
reviews.content:
Top Bar, excellent friendly staff,nothing too much trouble, great place for drinks and chilling out.
Good limited food menu but it’s a bar not a restaurant after all.
We couldn’t fault it and visited daily throughout our stay for a drink and a chat.
Highly Recommended.

reviews.author: Kara W
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content:
Went for food with my family while waiting to transfer to the airport.
Amazing place with stunning views of the marina.
Very reasonably priced and the food was amazing.
Would highly recommend you try it

reviews.author: Elizabeth D
reviews.title: Relaxing drink!
reviews.content: We went here for a few drinks along the Marina, after doing a tour. Beautiful, comfortable seating area & it's shaded. My husband and i took full advantage of the half price cocktails from 6pm-8pm. Really lovely waiting staff too.

reviews.author: Suibh
reviews.title: Fun night out!
reviews.content: Fantastic staff, very accommodating and friendly. The bar is in a great location at the marina also with wonderful views from the terrace. We had a great night at Sharky’s Bar.

reviews.author: stepho89
reviews.title: Excellent location
reviews.content:
Excellent cocktails & service. 
Reasonable price for drinks and we loved the location , right on the marina. The service we had was brilliant & friendly

reviews.author: finandcath
reviews.title: Great food and location
reviews.content:
We thoroughly enjoyed our food and service on a few occasions , until we encountered a rude member of staff . I wrote on a Facebook forum regarding this and was contacted by the manager of Sharkys who asked for full details and apologised . 
We are heading back to Portugal and will be sure to visit again - as the food  and other staff were absolutely amazing . 
Thank you

reviews.author: Ampie82
reviews.title: Good at first but bad service one night out us off
reviews.content:
I was away with my Wife and my family. My wife and I went for lunch a couple of times and the food and service was fantastic. 

We talked our family into going for dinner here one night. We were welcomed by a nice guy who pointed to a table (which had 6 seats) and told us we could drag a 7th over. A staff member said “give me a minute” in a very rude tone. We did wait and then as bringing the chair over, she said we weren’t to do that. We decided to go somewhere else for dinner as it seemed like a lot of hassle. The following day, my Wife and I were in Fat Cats and heard the staff member being rude to someone else. 

It was a real pity as before this, the service had been excellent and we really enjoyed it. This was quite early into our 2 weeks and we decided not to go back. Gave an average score to balance the good and bad service we received.

reviews.author: Apnyc2010
reviews.title: Good cocktails and good location
reviews.content: Lovely cocktails, brilliant prices especially at happy hour. Nice chilled settings overlooking the marina, comfy seats.

reviews.author: pricey43
reviews.title: Great food and drinks
reviews.content:
Stumbled upon this little gem when having a walk around the marina , great setting , comfortable seating area , lovely food and drinks and the two young girls serving are a credit to the establishment! 
Highly recommend

reviews.author: Dave L
reviews.title: Great spot & good cocktails
reviews.content:
Great little spot along the marina, lovely comfortable chairs overlooking the boats, took advantage of the half price cocktails. 
The best thing was that they were not watered down versions just during happy “hour”
Easily go back

reviews.author: Mark C
reviews.title: Very good and ate there several times.
reviews.content: Amazing service food and very comfortable. If you want somewhere for a great portioned lunch it is well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Hannah G
reviews.title: Lovely little bar
reviews.content: Popped in for a cocktail and a pint. Staff were friendly, drinks were standard price. Mojito was lovely!! Would recommend

reviews.author: Theredsliverpool
reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.content: Went to this bar more than once it does amazing cocktails (half price between 6pm and 8pm) lovely staff and beautiful views of the marina would highly recommend 😀😀

reviews.author: Paddington Bear
reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.content: Fantastic place on the marina. Wonderful team and service.  Highly recommend you visit. A really great atmosphere. Thank you for the hospitality and beer. They have a great menu, with a large selection of burgers + fish & chips. You will be amongst friends during your visit

reviews.author: Jack B
reviews.title: Good place for marina views
reviews.content: Nice place to visit after doing a bout tour, lovely view over the marina with comfy outdoor seating, cheap alcohol and food was reasonable and tasted good! Service was great!

reviews.author: Simon R
reviews.title: 5 stars from us!
reviews.content: Great food, lots of it and all in fantastic surroundings. The team at Sharkys are all super friendly and can't do enough. 5 stars from us!

reviews.author: Aloha1313
reviews.title: Parfait pour le dejeuner
reviews.content:
Mike nous a très bien accueilli ce midi, on y retourne demain soir pour les cocktails...
Déjeuner très simple, burger, croc, hot dog, frites aux fromage... un repas simple avant de partir en mer.

reviews.author: Charlie & Kath
reviews.title: 5 STARS is NOT Enough!
reviews.content:
We visited here twice as a group of 6 during our 4 night break, as my Brother-in-Law knows the owner from School. We came once in the afternoon for Cocktails and once again for lunch as the food looked SO good when we seen it. AND IT WAS! 

Everything from the Service, Drinks, and Food was FANTASTIC! Complimented with the view of the marina, it is a MUST to visit when in Albufeira! They do have several TV's showing sport too if required! 

It is very difficult to leave once you are sat on the comfy sofa's, a view of the marina, a cold beer and good food served to you! Why would you want to go anywhere else!?

The young chap (Ginger/Blonde) hair that served us was Spot on! If the owners read this, please pass on our thanks, he is a credit to you. 

Well done Sharky's Bar….we 100% will be back!! (Hopefully you are not running in the Marathon this time!)   

Charlie, Kathryn Rowe, Martyn Rowe, Sarah, Hayley & Tink.

reviews.author: Ross B
reviews.title: Friendly sports bar!
reviews.content: Friendly staff, ideally located on the marina, we watched a Premier League game and had a few reasonably priced drinks.

reviews.author: Lucy C
reviews.title: Lovely lunch - great setting and value for money
reviews.content: We visited sharkys for lunch today - it was great value for money and the staff were very helpful.  We had the wraps which had a generous amount of filling and were delicious.  Great place to sit and watch the world go by on the marina

reviews.author: Elle
reviews.title: Great place 👌
reviews.content: Our 2nd visit to ' sharky's great cocktails, great service, especially from the ginger/blonde young waiter, very friendly & smiley ☺️and the young lady that was just finishing her shift..not so much the other waiter though, needs to sharpen up on his people skills..

reviews.author: RichardtKnightWDF
reviews.title: 10/10. Perfect for lunch. Incredible fish finger sandwich
reviews.content:
Wish we’d found Sharkys soon. Perfect for a great lunch. They even have Fish finger sandwiches. 

Great location, very friendly staff.

reviews.author: martiev45
reviews.title: Good drinks
reviews.content: Cocktails was good ...good Coffee as well ...the guys  on the staff was friendly  ...there was one short girl ..she was  bossy and not all that frienly ....could have been a busy moment  or not her day ...Who knows ...price friendly as well ...otherwise a good vibe

reviews.author: P Gouveia
reviews.title: Serviço muito mau
reviews.content: Serviço muito mau. Não limpam as mesas, nem mesmo quando é pedido. O frango do hambúrguer vinha extremamente seco e tinha alface estragada. A gerência é mal educada quando se faz uma crítica construtiva, desculpando-se que os seus empregados não falam português.

reviews.author: SofiaSota
reviews.title: Muito mau
reviews.content:
Serviço de má qualidade
Comida mais ou menos mas não vale o preço.
O hambúrguer vinha queimado e as mesas não são limpas.
Empregados muito mal-educados e nem português sabem falar.

reviews.author: cmeade10
reviews.title: Chilling by the beautiful Marina
reviews.content: The setting is just beautiful on the Marina. We had day 2 of a wedding here. It was just so perfect and relaxing. The staff here are just amazing. We were so well looked after. We returned several times during our stay. Would highly recommend

reviews.author: dendac d
reviews.title: Désagréable au possible, ne nous donne pas la carte et nous disent qu’ils ont 2 tables pleines et que cela va être long
reviews.content: Désagréable au possible, ne nous donne pas la carte et nous disent qu’ils ont 2 tables pleines et que cela va être long. Les 2 serveuses sont très désagréables

reviews.author: David
reviews.title: Excellent Bar, Staff, Cocktails!
reviews.content:
We were staying in the apartments on the marina just above this bar. Went here most evenings during our 10 night stay. Excellent half price Cocktails between 6-8pm which my wife tried almost everyone on the menu! The beer was also very good.

The staff were all excellent with a special mention to the young scottish lady who was so friendly with all the customers and fluent in many languages.

reviews.author: Holly M
reviews.title: Fab place to drink/eat
reviews.content: My partner and I have loved spending time at the marina during our holiday and have loved drinking here due to its relaxed atmosphere!  Staff are so attentive and friendly☺️

reviews.author: kelvhatch
reviews.title: Great Bar Great Staff Great Lication
reviews.content:
Excellent bar, I visit the Algarve 4 or 5 times a year. 
Great atmosphere and very friendly staff.

I always visit bar when I am in Albufeira.

When I have my brother and his wife with me they really enjoy coming down here.

Highly recommend the odd visit or six.

reviews.author: Gunita G
reviews.title: Cocktails #good #waibs
reviews.content: Very nice  koktails we get, the best cocktails ever I taste,nice staff ,nice food also, nice wiev,lots of experience, lots  of things to do

reviews.author: TaffyHeckler
reviews.title: Cracking place to meet and socialise on the Marina, ooh and his food is good as well!
reviews.content: Excellent place to meet and socialise. Chris is very accommodating with the TV selection, so we can watch F1 whilst footy is on as well for other customers. Lovely outdoor seating overlooking the marina. Attentive staff.

reviews.author: chlo_gai
reviews.title: Excellente adresse
reviews.content: Cadre idyllique sur le bord de la marina, ambiance cosy, serveurs ultra sympas, ils parlent anglais, et prix plus que corrects (7€ les 2 cocktails en happy hour), délicieux ! Passage obligatoire si vous êtes sur Albufeira !

reviews.author: Bríd Corrigan
reviews.title: 10/10 would recommend
reviews.content: Lovely bar & restaurant right beside the marina. Great atmosphere and staff. Had the grilled chicken burger and strawberry mojito on our first night and had to come back again during the holiday it was so good!!

reviews.author: Mazza Schmidt
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.content: Great bar, lovely friendly staff, can’t do enough for you and the food is delicious and fresh and can’t recommend enough. Spend a lovely couple of afternoons watching the rugby and enjoying cocktails

reviews.author: Jennifer R
reviews.title: Très bons burgers et personnel très sympa !
reviews.content: Le cadre est agréable avec un terrasse au bord de l'eau dans le port d'Albufeira. Le personnel est vraiment très sympa et accueillant. Nous sommes arrivé à 20h05 et ils nous ont quand même offert un cocktail bien que l'offre se terminait a 20h00. Les burgers étaient très bons et très copieux. Soirée de match oblige il y avait 2 télés en terrasses plus deux autres a l'intérieur. Parfait !

reviews.author: DavemScotland
reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.content:
Best little bar in the marina.
We found it early on our holiday and started each evening there (and often finished there too).
Two for one cocktails between 6 and 8pm extremely good value. Two Aperol Spritz for 7 euros for example. 
Serve a really decent burger.
Very welcoming staff. 
Well done guys. Keep it up and see you next time.

reviews.author: Aileen D
reviews.title: Good food at an excellent location
reviews.content:
Recently visited the bar the location at the marina is excellent.  food and service also very good!

Would recommend a visit!

reviews.author: desertship
reviews.title: Great bar on the marina.
reviews.content:
Great little bar on the mariner which offers reasonable drinks with a very good selection.
 
Toasties and sandwiches are available which are freshly made and are very nice (the kids love the toasties)

They also have a happy hour 6-8 pm where they do 2 for 1 on the cocktails.

Staff are super friendly to all that go.

Always any live sports on the tv’s ( great for footy)

reviews.author: Natalie G
reviews.title: Fabulous bar , excellent location.
reviews.content: Fabulous bar, excellent location on the Marina. We called in for food and drinks and both were excellent.  Would highly recommend the Sharkys burger.  Special mention to Eddy who served us and Chris the owner, both made us feel very welcome.  We will be back .

reviews.author: Stevee17
reviews.title: Nice food, relaxed
reviews.content: End of marina strip, we had baguettes, burgers, I had the chicken piri piri burger, which was spicy. We ordered some additional fries too. We washed down with cocktails, beer. Witty service from waiter whom entertained daughters somewhat.

reviews.author: DR_de_Pauw
reviews.title: Koffie in de winterzon
reviews.content: Heerlijk terras om in het zonnetje van een kopje koffie te genieten. Met uitzicht op de haven en de kleurrijke huizen.

reviews.author: Mandy
reviews.title: Top Bar
reviews.content:
Televised sports great beer and great atmosphere. 
The food is all cooked greasy and the piri piri burger is seriously spicy

reviews.author: Nick H
reviews.title: Good food/drinks
reviews.content:
Went to Sharkeys for a few drinks and light bites got there after 11.30 pm still they were happy to cook for our party, fab service decent food 

Nic

reviews.author: Ronan Armstrong
reviews.title: Excellent Cocktail happy hour
reviews.content: I cannot recommend Sharky’s enough. The staff are so friendly and helpful and also offer the best happy hour my friends and I could find in Albufeira. Make sure to get to sharkys between 6-8 everyday.

reviews.author: John T
reviews.title: Fantastic Bar
reviews.content: Happy Hour was always good, fantastic location on the Marina. Friendly staff, great food. Love the expresso martini...……

reviews.author: B6990JLrichardm
reviews.title: Fabulous & friendly bar perfectly located on the vibrant Marina!
reviews.content: Chris and the team offer superb service, amazing cocktails and food along with a host of sports events.  Visiting the Marina on a regular basis, no trip is complete without a Sharky's Pink Gin or a bottle of white!   Make it your local and watch the sun go down or drop in for food, you will most certainly not be disappointed!

reviews.author: Lilianna Hamer
reviews.title: Excellent!!
reviews.content: Best bar on the Marina! Fab staff, so friendly and welcoming, always available to help when extremely busy, definitely recommend to come here with young kids , friends, families for a good time and a good game of pool!

reviews.author: Wayne
reviews.title: Fantastic friendly bar !
reviews.content: Had a few visits here during our recent stay in July this year. The staff are always very friendly and Eddy was always attentive and kept the drinks flowing. Drinks very reasonable and even better during happy hour offers.  Great place to relax and watch the sport or listen to music, play pool or just sit in the sun watching the world go by.

reviews.author: Daniel Nespoli
reviews.title: Albufeira's Number One
reviews.content: I love this place. I've been over to Albufeira a few times now and I always end up here. Chris and his team are extremely welcoming and they can't do enough to make sure you're comfortable and enjoying your time. Great atmosphere, food and a wide selection of drinks. I love the seating area in front of the marina and relaxing in front of the view. I can't recommend Sharky's highly enough to anyone who's looking for a family friendly bar and a relaxed atmosphere! I'm coming back at the end of August and this will be the first place I'm heading!

reviews.author: Widewheels
reviews.title: Great place for drinks and snacks
reviews.content:
This is where we head for when we’re on the marina and in need of refreshment.

Chris and his team always have a smile and a friendly welcome.

Snacks are of great quality and value, family favourites being the toasties, burgers and salads (especially the chicken one if you ask for it to be peri-peri’d).

We’ll be back....hopefully very soon.

reviews.author: Birksy
reviews.title: Absolutely Brilliant
reviews.content: Popped in for happy hour. Cocktails were fantastic, two guys working their socks off. Cocktails were fantastic, I'd pay £12 for on in Manchester. If you gp to the marina go here, fantastic bar, great location

reviews.author: al2015164
reviews.title: Nice pint and food
reviews.content: Blazing hot sunny day, ice cold beer, tasty food and friendly staff. What's not to like. Good for lunch, will return

reviews.author: Aquamar
reviews.title: Friendly bar
reviews.content:
Visited with family on a trip to Albufeira marina, warmly welcomed by Eddy who was very friendly and courteous.

Reasonable prices for drinks and courteous staff, highly recommended.

reviews.author: Gillian C
reviews.title: Love it
reviews.content: Drawn in with the happy hour offer, 2 for 1 cocktails and our 2 grandsons, 8 and 13, loved the kids cocktails and the pool table. The adult cocktails are gorgeous and if you dont want to sit inside they have a lovely outdoor area. The service was perfect and the staff are very friendly and approachable. Would def recommend and definately will visit again when we go back.

reviews.author: Oliver G
reviews.title: Sharks bar
reviews.content: Very Good!! The staff were very friendly and welcoming, pool table and brilliant food! Always recognised when we came back! Lovely atmosphere and view.

reviews.author: sarah h
reviews.title: Highly highly recommend!
reviews.content:
Fell apon this gem of a place almost by accident! The happy hour on coctails- 2 for 1- pulled us in and then we never wanted to leave! The coctails are sooooo good! The BEST expresso martini you will find for miles made by the wonderful Helen who just makes you feel so welcome and so at home! Our little girl had the bubble gum mocktail and it is amazing! Ask Helen to turn it into a cocktail...its gorgeous!
 Situated beautifully on the marina...you can sit looking out at all the wonderful boats and on chilly days...the bar area is just as inviting.
The food is delicious! We had the sharky burger which was amazing. The toasties, cheesy chips and chips are totally moreish! We didn't find anything nearly as good as here anywhere else! Exceptional value for money.
 Gutted we found you so late during our stay! We WILL be returning next year and can not wait to eat and drink with you again! Have an awesome summer season. You deserve to be packed out day and night.
Sarah, phil and freya.

reviews.author: janice c
reviews.title: Excellent bar
reviews.content: Absolutely love this place, never fail to visit when I come to Albufeira such a friendly place to be, Chris Helen and Eddie are more than helpful.

reviews.author: David R
reviews.title: Just a relaxing place
reviews.content: Spending a relaxing afternoon at our favourite pub in Albufeira! Have waited a week for them to open. Amazing piri piri chicken burger! Helen is lovely as usual!

reviews.author: Linda K
reviews.title: Mr
reviews.content: Unfortunately this bar although staff are very friendly they do not cater for disabled customers not physically disabled but mentally disabled.

reviews.author: Nuno Correia
reviews.title: Uma refeição acolhedora num local agradável
reviews.content:
Resolvemos fazer uma refeição ligeira neste bar. Staff muito simpático e prestável, comida bem elaborada, tempo de espera reduzido e preços simpáticos.
Muito bem situado, com uma esplanada muito agradável. O interior bem decorado e acolhedor.
Recomendo e voltarei.

reviews.author: marmy10
reviews.title: FANTASTIC PLACE!!!!!
reviews.content:
easily the best bar by the marina in albufeira….,,we had heard so many great things about this place before our holiday so had to check it out and so glad we did!
chris was brilliant and couldn't do enough for us,our 3 year old loved it as well and didn't want to leave!thanks again.HIGHLY RECOMMEND!!!

reviews.author: Tom T
reviews.title: The Best
reviews.content: Theres not a bad thing to say. These are the friendliest people you'll ever meet in Albufeira. The food is spot on, best toastie you'll ever taste. We went everyday for 2 weeks and the service and food was perfect every time. All the best to Chris, Ellen and Ewan and I hope to see them next year xx

reviews.author: villafc2018
reviews.title: AMAZING!!!!
reviews.content:
By far the best bar on the Albufeira Marina with fantastic views..

Chris, Helen and Ewan are extremely welcoming, friendly and always go that extra mile to ensure your visit is comfortable. The bar never fails to amaze.

We visited everyday and each day was made to feel like we was at home.

The Food is delicious with quick service, however I would highly recommend the Toasties...

Please check out this Bar for yourselves and you will definately NOT be disappointed.

reviews.author: Rui
reviews.title: Boring and unfriendly
reviews.content:
Bring back Eirik and Lin when it used to be fun 
The new owner lacks character and joy and the place is boring 
Sorry I been there

reviews.author: AnoukVanhex
reviews.title: Great food, great atmosphere
reviews.content: Mooie locatie, vriendelijk personeel, leuke bediening, lekker eten, gezellig terras aan het water, aanrader !!

reviews.author: Thomas H
reviews.title: Superb!
reviews.content: Just been here for food and a drink, absolutely superb! Food was quick, delicious, and was excellent value for money. Would highly recommend coming here, especially with the beautiful view of the marina

reviews.author: dodgerhoddesdon
reviews.title: PERFECTION!
reviews.content: What can i say about this fab little place!! Aside from the warm welcome and super friendly chatty staff, they do the best toasties in the WORLD!!!!!!!!!! Simply fabulous. If it had been more local to where we were staying We would have visited more often.

reviews.author: Celtic Fusions
reviews.title: Relax in the evening sun.
reviews.content: Sharky's is located at the far end of the marina, very much away from the crowd. The eveing sun falls here so you can while away the eveing in bliss.

reviews.author: dancsarbu
reviews.title: Best bar in Albufeira by far
reviews.content: If you want to have a good time with your friends in Albufeira or you want to watch a football match around people that know what they talk about when they talk sports go to Sharkey's. Good company and good drinks and food.

reviews.author: Billy Thomson
reviews.title: Having travelled often,I would say this is the friendlies bad I have ever been in.
reviews.content:
Amazing welcoming stereotyping is too much bother, I recommend without hesitation to all,
Lovely view over the Marina,if you visit  you will e greeted with the warmest of welcomes.
This review is posted having come to the end of a 6 Month winter stay,and not once have I seen an unhappy face,both Staff and customer alike
Billy

reviews.author: Ian J
reviews.title: Great Friendly Bar
reviews.content: Visited numerous time. Good selection of drinks, great team offering excellent service. Very friendly bar to meet people. Try it.

reviews.author: Loveportugal_10
reviews.title: Great bar and staff
reviews.content: Lovely bar that should be visited on any trip to Marina. Nice decor and outside deck. Staff are great and Chris is a star.

reviews.author: NicG92
reviews.title: Great place for a friendly drink
reviews.content: Have known the owner Chris for many years now and am made up he has made a success of his own bar. Helen is amazing and nothing is too much trouble. If you are looking for a great welcome in a lovely bar on the Marina then you won't go wrong.

reviews.author: lynn m
reviews.title: best bar on the marina
reviews.content:
This bar is so friendly, and it's great for lovely snacks. The owner Chris is a superb guy, so kind, helpful and full of fun. The other girls serving are a great asset to the bar also.
Try this bar near to the Spar supermarket at the marina, you will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: martina-olivia
reviews.title: Great wee bar at the Marina
reviews.content: Known Chris since Steps days, delighted Sharky's is doing fantastic, great place to chill out with a cold beer, or munch on a Sharky's burger, watching the boats and the world go by :-)

reviews.author: Scenic222889
reviews.title: Great bar
reviews.content:
Took a walk from old town to the marina to take a look at the boats and while there found sharkys bar so stopped off for a drink or three 
Very friendly staff and drinks at a very reasonable price 
Nice to sit on sun deck and enjoy the sun and relax

reviews.author: Alison P
reviews.title: Brilliant bar
reviews.content: What an amazing host, Chris goes above and beyond to make customers feel at home with his happy and positive attitude - can be a bit cheeky tho 😜Lovely relaxing environment - will even put in rugby league if you ask nicely.

reviews.author: Jan V
reviews.title: Leuke plaats !!  👍
reviews.content: Wil je s'middags lekker én goedkoop een snack eten ?   1 adres : sharky's bar in de haven van Albufeira !   Probeer zeker de alom gekende "sharky's burger" !!!

reviews.author: Nick T
reviews.title: Great stop off
reviews.content: Really great stop for a cold beer when it's getting to hot out. Stopped here many times for a cold pint or cheeky cocktail great snack menu with the best burgers around (sharky Burger 🍔) really friendly staff who where brilliant with my nephew (5 years old) a must stop off.

reviews.author: Helen S
reviews.title: Great Spot
reviews.content: Visit here every time we stay in the Orada Apartments. Great spot, friendly staff, good service. Reasonably priced

reviews.author: jazzmunich69
reviews.title: Always top notch
reviews.content:
Sharky's is a regular stop for us either before or after dinner or both! Chris and Helen are great hosts. I can honestly say we started going to Sharky's as visitors and are now friends. 
Helen's G&T is great...👍👍

reviews.author: HolidayBrian
reviews.title: Excellent Bar
reviews.content: Arguably the friendliest bar in Albufeira. I don`t ever recall going in & Chris not asking how I am or how my day is going. Helen & the new girl are friendly also. Nice new relaxing terrace for this season. Drinks always ice cold. We used to go in for the amazing toasties at a reasonable price. Tuna melt being the popular choice. One small piece of advice tho. Need to speed up the food service. Still love you guys. See you next year!

reviews.author: sophieah
reviews.title: Nice
reviews.content: Lovely toasties at a reasonable price with good service. Although it maybe took a bit longer than expected considering there was no one else waiting for food.

reviews.author: 29Eric57
reviews.title: Excellent bar for eating and drink down the marina
reviews.content: Just returned from 10 days in Albufeira and visited Sharkys every day.  Pleasant stoll down from the old town, staff excellent, owner Chris goes the extra mile to ensure your having a good time.  Good choice of burgers and bagettes and an excellent pimt.  Perfect spot for watching sport and just chilling.  Will be back in September, cant wait!!!

reviews.author: Carl B
reviews.title: Great bar
reviews.content: Great to see Chris again not changed since we last seen him in the blue bell bar, Chris now owns sharky's bar in the marina so paid him visit, great bar simply food but freshly made to order, very clean and Chris always makes you feel welcome definitely will be back in the next couple of months and would highly recommend if your in the marina pay him a visit

reviews.author: Lewis T
reviews.title: The best bar for miles around !
reviews.content: Went to Albufiera with 5 mates and this was the first stop on our way to the new town every night ! stopped here on our first night and made it a regular thing. Sharky's is hands down one of the best bars ive been to ! friendly and attentive staff who always go out of their way to ensure you have a great experience. The fact all of the staff are English helps aswell ! The food they serve is out of this world ! i would recommend Sharky's to anyone staying around the Marina. thank you for looking after us during our stay !

reviews.author: Jason H
reviews.title: Excellent little bar
reviews.content: Had the best burger I've tasted here! Amazing snacks, great hospitality, and amazing location. Staff were very attentive and the atmosphere was very laid back and friendly

reviews.author: Prewett22
reviews.title: Great bar
reviews.content: Fantastic bar with great staff and fantastic food, went with five mates and would definitely go back if we return to albufiera!

reviews.author: ColinMason
reviews.title: Best bar on Marina
reviews.content: ManxK - the name is about right!!!. Your review in Mank!!! The greatest bar on the Marina with a well tried and tested landlord who has done a huge amount of work to upgrade this very popular bar and also has two very professional barmaids. And who else could arrange for most of the staff of three very popular Soaps in the UK and a few pop stars to come here and play football on the 29th April at Guia Football stadium for the Bombeiros charity. The atmosphere is great, the food is great and the drinks are good, and together with the entertainment along the Marina, you could your whole holiday there. And there's further developments occurring. Keep it up Chris, Helen and Anna.

reviews.author: lynn m
reviews.title: Great gem on the marina
reviews.content: Very friendly bar,good quality snacks attentive staff and superb cocktails, cold beer etc overlooking marina life. Come on down.

reviews.author: 268james
reviews.title: Sensational Sharkey's
reviews.content: Unaccustomed as l am to writing reviews on any website, l cannot state strongly enough that this bar has such a friendly, laid back atmosphere, great vibe and excellent service in a fantastic location. The staff have incredible rapport with all their customers. If you are looking for a loud rave bar, then this is not it. But if you are looking for a relaxed sports bar, great atmosphere and incredible food, this is it.

reviews.author: Paul
reviews.title: Use to be better
reviews.content: This place is not the same with the new owners .. We had spent many off late nights in here when Lyn owned it but your made to feel unwelcome and rushed to get you out

reviews.author: Edie C
reviews.title: Best bar in the Harbour
reviews.content: Best bar in the harbour Chris so friendly and food great. You are made so welcome the bar is lovely. Would come back again when we're next in Portugal.

reviews.author: SteveP1985
reviews.title: Best burgers in town!
reviews.content: One of the greatest bars in Albufeira, and very refreshing to have something in the Marina with so much life and a friendly atmosphere. We stayed in accommodation at the Marina on a recent family holiday, and for the first time, felt no need to even go in to the old town, as Sharky's became a favourite hangout. Perfect for a snack in the day and a chill, burgers are second to none, and all reasonably priced. The bar staff are very accommodating and friendly too.

reviews.author: vixxx89
reviews.title: Lovely welcome
reviews.content: What a lovely environment to be in the welcome is great have been a few times now. Food was lovely, Chris and the other staff were knowledgeable about the area and a pleasure to spend time with. Nice environment cocktails were lovely. Seating outside is a nice touch. The Mocktails with the sharkys cups were a perfect  for my children, definitely worth visiting we will be back again soon.

reviews.author: Manx K
reviews.title: Boredom
reviews.content:
This has to be the most boring venue in the area.

Two couples and a single guy staring into space, no atmosphere what so ever.

At the end of the marina, totally lifeless, cold dark and utterly boring.

Give up guys and open something with a bit of life.

reviews.author: Juaaaan1978
reviews.title: Must see for yourself
reviews.content: Hands down the best Bar in Albufeira a 10 minute walk from the old town to the Marina, I highly recommend. Best beer, freindlislest staff, best cocktails, cheapest prices, lovely food, decent music, the best customers (especially the regulars), banter, every live football game shown, sun all day until it goes away, fabulous views, dog friendly. Do it!

reviews.author: t_kaethe
reviews.title: Ein schnelles Eis...
reviews.content: Leicht genervte Bedienung, weil wir nicht portugiesisch sprachen. Eis relativ teuer und zT offensichtlich mit Farbstoffen aufgehübscht.

reviews.author: Steve H
reviews.title: Great bar in the Marina
reviews.content: Visited with friends in March/April, popped in for a beer and snack because we knew Chris the owner had taken the bar over. Food was really nice, only snacks like baguettes, toasties and burgers but a lovely filler. Chris is a great guy and makes all his customers feel welcome. All the footie matches are shown as an extra bonus.

reviews.author: AnoukVanhex
reviews.title: Gezellig
reviews.content: Vriendelijke uitbater en personeel, mooie locatie met zicht op de haven, terras aan het water! Snacks op de kaart zijn altijd heel lekker, prijs-kwaliteit is goed !

reviews.author: Bertyloo
reviews.title: Usual excellent service
reviews.content:
Our second visit to Sharky's bar was what we expected, great lunch and reasonably priced drinks, as always well looked after by owner Chris, who has time for all his customers, which makes everyone feel welcome.
Sure to be our local when staying at The Marina in May

reviews.author: Lorraine L
reviews.title: Lovely
reviews.content: Went here after our boat ride nice clean and friendly staff lovely toasties and baguettes would defo go back

reviews.author: waffle41
reviews.title: Afternoon stop off.
reviews.content: Great bar and well priced, Chris the owner is a very nice guy and always ready for a chat. Back in 3 days..Nov 2016.

reviews.author: Neil K
reviews.title: Fantastic friendly Marina bar.
reviews.content:
This is a fabulous friendly bar located in the Marina , we were bimbling around this lovely area when we chanced on this superb inviting bar.
Walking in and its a cosy place and the staff made us so welcomed,the bar itself is superb with a nautical theme attached  with ships Anchors on the wall's,boat photos and the like ,just one cool place.
We ordered some beer's and opted for bottles of Super Bock and we just chilled out sitting outside on their great little terrace. 
We had a very pleasant time here looking out onto the marina enjoying our iced cold beer before we moved .
Very easy to locate on Passeio Do Ouro,Albufeira marina. 
A great bar and well worth checking out.

reviews.author: Stephen K
reviews.title: Great Bar On The Marina
reviews.content:
Sharky's bar is located on Albufeira Marina and is an excellent bar to visit when in the Marina area of Albufeira.Sharky's bar must be one of the cleanest bars we visited and also one of the friendliest'that has on offer an excellent food and drinks menu.A great bar that has excellent seating areas inside as well as outside.This is a great bar to go to when visiting the Marina for a few beers or a tasty meal.We had just been to one of the Irish pubs on the Marina and went into Sharky's bar as they were showing one of the Premier League football games in here between Tottenham and Manchester City. It was quite busy in here but we managed to get a good seat and had a few bottles of Super Bock which were excellent and at a very reasonable price.This is a first rate bar in a great location that has nice staff.  Located on the Passeio do Ouro/Marina de Albufeira.
Opening hours are. 
Monday-Sunday-Don't Know.

reviews.author: Tia856
reviews.title: Best bar on the marina
reviews.content: Came to Albufeira Marina for a winter sun break. Sharkys was recommend to us. We certainly 100% pass on the recommendation. Chris & his staff made us feel welcome & couldn't do enough.. drinks & food superb. This became our bolt hole each evening after a long day out in the sun.. recommend anyone who comes to the marina must call in at Sharkys for a cold beer, glass of vino & snacks all served with a smile.

reviews.author: Portugal10
reviews.title: Lovely bar
reviews.content:
I would recommend everyone to visit Sharkys
Chris Who owns the bar  cannot do enough for you
 Lovely bar snacks available and excellent choice of drinks. Helen makes you all feel very welcome.  Cannot wait to visit again when we are back in albufeira

reviews.author: L T
reviews.title: Fab Food
reviews.content:
Just back from a week in Albufeira and can'recommend Sharky's enough for snack lunches.

Located at the end of the marina it is worth the extra steps.

Warm reception from the friendly staff.

reviews.author: Lou S
reviews.title: The best
reviews.content: A great place. We were welcomed every time with a smile, great food and drinks. Oh and of course bread for Freddie

reviews.author: Julabell65
reviews.title: Friendly feel good bar
reviews.content: As we stayed nearer the other end of the marina, we didn't visit this bar until nearly the end of our holidays,  which was unfortunate as we would definetely have visited more.  Was quite quiet the eve we visited but Chris the owner gave us good info on visiting vilamoura the next day,  he was also vy happy to chat to us ( we are very inquisitive abt brits  abroad lol) lovely bar on the marina, well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Bill S
reviews.title: Nothing fancy but well worth a visit.
reviews.content: Have gone to this little friendly bar a few times during our holiday.  It does not look anything fancy compared to some of the decor of other establishments at the marina but it is comfortable and NOT over priced.  The service and food are excellent.  It's the very last bar at the end of the marina and well worth a visit.

reviews.author: Rachel J
reviews.title: Great bar on the marina
reviews.content: Just spent a week in Albuferia. We visited Sharkeys Bar every day usually for lunch and sometimes an evening as well for a drink.  Great service by Chris, Helen & Julia and not a problem doing a snack variation for my gluten free husband. We will certainly be back as it is a great place to sit and enjoy the marina views.

reviews.author: John F
reviews.title: Fantastic little bar by the marina
reviews.content: Just spent 10 days in villa by the marina. Sharkys was first bar we came to on way to old town and more often than not we could not go past without calling in. Friendly hosts, spotless , beer excellent , smashing food, Pool table, what more can I say - nothing else by the marina to touch Sharkys. Do not go to the marina without popping in

reviews.author: Krb1967
reviews.title: What happened to the table service?
reviews.content: We have been visiting this bar for years. Thought we'd give the new owner a chance, seemed pleasant enough. However, it fell down on two accounts: firstly, no free crisps and secondly, no table service. What would Linn say?!

reviews.author: t-pott72
reviews.title: Cracking bar!!!
reviews.content: Love this bar, great atmosphere and a lovely selection of snacks such as burgers, salads, toasties and sandwiches which are to die for. The staff make you feel so welcome as there is a real buzz about this place. Chris the bar owner has really stamped his mark on this bar accommodating for everyone`s needs and nothing is too much for him, a really friendly guy with a promising future ahead.

reviews.author: carly_smith3
reviews.title: Best G & T's in town
reviews.content: This bar was recommended to us and what a lovely bar it is. Very friendly staff and good value for money. Lovely G & T's had by all our gang. Will be back soon for sure 😄

reviews.author: J Baird
reviews.title: Fin tastic
reviews.content: Lovely pub really nice staff great location and prices really clean great for football big comfy sofas

reviews.author: Dai C
reviews.title: Chris is still the man.
reviews.content: Back to Albufeira for another summer holiday, first time visiting Chris running his own bar in the marina. Great to see that he's still the same friendly, welcoming guy he was when he ran the Blue Bell in the Old Town. Bar has a nicely chilled atmosphere, brilliant staff and the food is fantastic . If you were a patron of the Blue Bell come to the marina and pay him a visit- guarantee you won't be disappointed.

reviews.author: Carol F
reviews.title: Sharky's Bar Albufeira Marina a Fantastic Place
reviews.content: Sharky's Bar is a fantastic place to visit if you are on your own, with friends or with your family, it has a great friendly atmosphere with good fresh food.  Chris is a great host and his staff Helen can't do enough to help.  Would definitely recommend a visit to anyone visiting Alufeira.

reviews.author: Moira U
reviews.title: Great place
reviews.content: Absolutely brilliant place Chris and his staff can' do enough for you great place at the Marine in Albeufeira very friendly and very relaxed atmosphere

reviews.author: jazzmunich69
reviews.title: Great host
reviews.content: Sharky's is a local bar that we've visited many times. Chris who owns the bar is a great host and brilliant with the kids. Chris and Helen make a fantastic combination running the bar and making our visits the best!! Good drinks and great company!

reviews.author: Lorraine R
reviews.title: Sharkey's Bar Marina Albufeira
reviews.content:
A fantastic bar at the Marina Albufeira a fave with ex pat's and holiday makers a like  a great friendly atmosphere staff are very welcoming and eager to please .
The food is freshly cooked to order and very delicious to ...drinks are probably cheapest on the marina with great views ,decking area a real suntrap ....sport channels are on for the latest games ..pool table.... a must to visit day or night .

reviews.author: Ady W
reviews.title: Sharkey"s Bar little gem at Albufeira Marina
reviews.content: Little gem on the marina Albufeira friendly staff Chris the bar owner always up for banter with his customers...food and drinks at really good prices...lovely decking area with beautiful views and a great sun trap...A must the famous Sharkey Burger on offer can" t beat it also other great snacks teamed up with all the sports on TV  what more could you ask for  deffo a place to visit.

reviews.author: garybrannan
reviews.title: The best little bar on the marina.
reviews.content: They can't do enough for you to make your visit perfect. The food is bang on and I have eaten further down the marina and I wish I'd had walked the extra 100yards, it's not a full blown restaurant but a bar with bar food which is perfect for what I wanted at that time.

reviews.author: unmissable2185
reviews.title: Lovely friendly bar
reviews.content: First time at sharky's and really liked the vibe there. Only popped in for a bite to eat before a boat trip. Food was great, staff were lovely and the alsatian dog was a little beaut. Location is great too. Would love to visit on a night time,,, if its anything like the atsmophere is steps bar then its a winner all round 😊

reviews.author: 394garethw
reviews.title: Friendly Bar worth the walk
reviews.content: We Stopped in a villa on the marina and this was the go to bar when we headed out or was watching sport. The Staff and all the customers were very friendly. I never tried the food but it looked good and the drinks prices were very reasonable up to half the price of some bars in town. Its the last bar on the row of resturants/bars on the marina and worth the walk.

reviews.author: Michael R
reviews.title: Fantastic bar
reviews.content: Fantastic place to have drinks and food. Everything on the menu you cannot fault. Prices are very reasonable. Once you have been here you won't want to go anywhere else. Chris does a fantastic job. All of staff there are always courteous and serve you very quickly. Couldnt of picked a better bar to spend our time in Albuferia Marina. Big thanks to Chris for making our honeymoon enjoyable!!

reviews.author: ChrisBotany
reviews.title: Best bar in Albufeira
reviews.content: This is a wonderful bar in the marina complex and a  great place to chill out. There is a sun deck and even an outside pool table. Bar snacks are excellent. It is also stylish and spotlessly clean. When I was there the bar was being run by either Chris or Helen. Chris is an excellent host and Helen perfect with her warm friendly personality. However its the drinks that are the main attraction with a wide range available. In particular the gin and tonics made by Chris and Helen are to die for.  Be warned though if you start your evening off here you won't want to go anywhere else !!

reviews.author: LEARN2SAIL
reviews.title: Great atmosphere. Really friendly staff
reviews.content:
Stopped by Sharky s Bar for lunch. Great atmosphere. Lots of ex pats enjoying the sunshine. Really friendly welcome. Will definitely be back

Mark

reviews.author: Davidsidney
reviews.title: New year break
reviews.content: Bright and fresh, fab position right in the Marina, but best of all Chris is a fab host. If you are down that was you must pay this bar a visit. Beer, G&T and toasties was great. Will be going back next time we are in Albufeira.

reviews.author: Sandlew00d
reviews.title: Wonderful service , food and view
reviews.content: Great place for a meal and a beverage.  What a delightful view.  Nice clean seating inside and out.   Loved the meal and it was nicely presented.    Perfect service.  An ideal stop when in Albuferia.

reviews.author: mario C
reviews.title: Sitio perfecto para una copa
reviews.content: Sitio perfecto para una copa en el puerto deportivo de albufeira. El personal muy atento además la camarera te entiende en castellano.

reviews.author: Carol W
reviews.title: Cracking little friendly bar
reviews.content: After a lovely walk we decided to visit Sharkys bar in the Marina for the first time since being under new ownership. What a cracking lovely relaxed bar, Chris the new owner is a wonderfully friendly host. Sit in or out and watch the world go by, the Marina has something for everyone or just sit n relax and have the  odd beer or two n snacks if you want. Good luck for the summer Chris
